name: Thruster Charge
author: Henning Berge
description: Going Commando's Charge Boots charge on Clank's Thruster-Pack, running Going Commando's own copied code: with the Thruster-Pack on, double-tap R1 and hold to charge along his facing, steering with the stick; enemies in the way are hit, a wall bonks him back. It replaces the Thruster-Pack's hover; its long jump and air boost stay. Needs OpenRAC with the rac1.player.update_movement hook point.

settings.name: Speed
settings.description: Times Going Commando's charge speeds (11.5 units a second, 30 in the first second).
